_comment: The numbers the page states as fact. Edit here and nowhere else: app.js fills them in at runtime, build.mjs bakes them into the pre-rendered pages, and npm run check fails if any of them drift out of sync. Spotify's public API publishes neither of these, so both are entered by hand — see assets/data/README.md.

monthly_listeners.source: Spotify for Artists (artist-supplied; 251,063 in the July 2026 data pack)
